authorization: User requested event/variability feasibility and four-condition SPPB comparison, with camera compatibility checked first.
source: 44 people, five optical motion capture trials per person; released CSV events and CGM2.3 joint centres. SPPB supplied total only. No new downloads or GPU training.

features.speed: Mean across five trials of pelvis-centre forward displacement / observed duration, metres per second.
features.PCI: For each side, 360*(contralateral strike - ipsilateral strike)/(next ipsilateral strike - ipsilateral strike), using cycles containing exactly one opposite strike. Pool phases across trials without connecting boundaries; PCI=100*sampleSD(phase)/mean(phase)+100*mean(abs(phase-180))/180. Average left and right PCI. Require at least15 valid phases per side across trials.
features.variability: Within each trial and side: stride duration, step length (heel separation along travel at heel strike), swing duration as percent stride. Pool within-trial-side centred sums of squares / pooled degrees of freedom, divide by grand mean, multiply100. This removes between-side/trial mean shifts; not SD of five trial averages. Require at least15 observations per side for each variable.
features.frame_alignment: CSV event seconds*100 matches stored frame numbers; verify sample C3D and supplied cycle summaries. No invented events. Reject missing or out-of-range interpolation and nonalternating cycles. No clinical score based exclusions.
features.aggregation: One feature row/person. All five trials for event features; eligible >=124-frame trials only for frozen GDI. Observation durations differ and are reported. No pooling gaps between trials.

camera.source: Kidzinski2020 Methods: fixed-position camera rotates about vertical axis following patient, distance3-4m,29.97fps.
camera.primary: Perspective camera right of walking direction at distance3.5m, height1m,640x480,60deg horizontal FOV, yaw tracks pelvis. World progression maps image leftward as in pinned input orientation. Height/FOV are explicit assumptions, not recovered calibration.
camera.time: Native100Hz to29.97Hz on physical time;124 observed samples; same starts0,31,...,372 limited by observed duration; no stretching,padding or gap filling. Reject required points outside frame.
camera.joints: Use supplied LHJC/RHJC,LKJC/RKJC,LAJC/RAJC, verify duplicate columns agree and centres differ plausibly from skin markers. TOE is a metatarsal-region proxy, not verified BODY25 big toe; strict anatomical equivalence remains false.
camera.sensitivity: Full frozen predictor, same people and common trial/window starts: toe proxy moved60mm along heel-to-toe direction; camera distance4m. These arbitrary scenarios assess sensitivity, not anatomical correction. No selection using SPPB.
camera.gate: Audit geometry, time and centres and inspect projections before inference. Permit explicitly labelled simulation with toe proxy; no claim of camera-ready or clinical GDI validity.

frozen_model: Existing54-checkpoint CNN/STT/bilateral fusion from 20261102-final223-frozen/models.json; hash check, old prediction replay, zero optimizer steps. Equal window then trial then CP outer-fold ensemble averaging. Keep original calibration. No protected223 samples/labels accessed.
evaluation: Use existing44-person five outer folds. Within each outer training set, three shuffled folds random_state20261031 to select Ridge alpha[0.1,1,10,100,1000] by person MAE, first candidate tie. Training-only standardization. Same model class/search in A-D, no output clipping. Save all fits, choices, IDs and replay. Constant training mean/median controls. Main A-D on common eligible people; secondary A/C on all event-eligible44; age65plus held-out subgroup descriptive, no refitting.
metrics: Person MAE primary; RMSE,bias,R2,Spearman,within1,errors>2, scorebands5-8,9-10,11-12. Exploratory SPPB<=8 detection using fixed predicted<=8 threshold: recall,specificity,confusion. Paired fixed-OOF person bootstrap10000 seed20261103, percentile95CI for C-A,D-C,D-A,B-A; conditional uncertainty not full retraining or external validation.
limits: Repeated-use small development cohort, not all >=65, absentSPPB0-4, optical/annotated events not video estimates, camera/toe/timebase domain gaps, exclusion may favour slower walkers. Statistical association is not clinical validation. Only SPPB total available; no fabricated subscores/TUG.
